title: Fizza Menda Akhri Vela Hay
body:
Karbal Ton Ghin Kay Shaam Tayeen (x2) Zainab Di Rida Hon Ta Bananay .
<<DIVIDER>>
Matan Kayn Dor Ich Sar Zainab Tay Chaan Veeran Di Thi Khatam Wanjay (x2)
Pathran Day Masum Vich Eiday (x2) Saar Tay Saya Hun Tayn Bananay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ashoor Di Luti Howi Zainab Tay Jadan Sham-e-Ghariban Lah Paway (x2)
Jeewain Putar Ko Chaway Sholayan Vich (x2) Ondi Ain Gawah Hun Tayn Bananay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadan Chok Tay Dhair Hajom Howay Mendi Bhen Banaween Rah Eida (x2)
Bazaar Ich Aasra Ujri Da (x2) Vish Shaam Day Raah Hun Tayn Bananay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadan Shaam Ich Zakham Milay Ainja Saan Ghutan Lagay Ainday Nasir (x2)
Maindi Tarfon Jholi Paain Tu (x2) Einday Aman Di Jaa Hun Tayn Bananay.
